notes: These are **official cutoffs as reproduced from IBPS result notices by the sources listed on each entry** — decimals may differ by ±0.25 between reproductions; the IBPS PDF on ibps.in is always canonical. IBPS PO has **no state-wise cutoffs** — merit is all-India. Three different scales are involved, so read the maxMarks on each row: **Prelims out of 100** (qualifying only, with sectional minimums plus a category-wise shortlist), **Mains out of 225** (200 objective + 25 descriptive; sectional minimums plus a total needed to reach the interview), and the **final combined score out of 100** built as 80% Mains + 20% Interview. The prelims marking itself changed recently (Reasoning 40, Quant 30, English 30 of the 100 marks), so raw year-on-year comparisons of prelims scores are only indicative. Cut-offs move with vacancies (3,049 in 2023 → 7,565 in 2026), shift difficulty after normalisation, and the size of the serious-candidate pool — treat them as a target band, not a promise.
